about: Known client-visible Rust gaps found by client_rpc_parity.py against the pinned reference. Each case fails CI if it starts passing; remove it then. severity is for real client use: critical breaks a core flow, high breaks a feature, medium shows wrong data, low differs without visible effect.

projects.filesystem.browse.reason: filesystem.browse keeps the trailing slash in parentPath
projects.filesystem.browse.issue: the reference normalizes parentPath to the directory without a trailing slash

projects.http.snapshot.afterDelete.reason: GET /api/projects still lists a deleted project
projects.http.snapshot.afterDelete.issue: the reference omits projects with deletedAt set

projects.readFile.issue: extra key not in ProjectReadFileResult; the client ignores it, but replies differ

projects.readFile.afterWrite.issue: extra key not in ProjectReadFileResult; the client ignores it, but replies differ

raw.projects.readFile#5.issue: extra key not in ProjectReadFileResult; the client ignores it, but replies differ

raw.projects.readFile#6.reason: projects.readFile error for a missing file has a different operation and cause
raw.projects.readFile#6.issue: the reference reports operation realpath-target with a WorkspaceFileSystemOperationError cause; Rust reports read and an io error string

turns.getThreadProjection.afterMessage.reason: the projection after a message lacks the reference's provider runtime records and uses other ids
turns.getThreadProjection.afterMessage.issue: no attempts, nodes or providerThreads; runs have UUID ids, not run:thread:<id>:ordinal:<n>, and messages carry no nodeId; extra checkpoint and checkpointScope records

turns.subscribeCommandOutput.missing.reason: subscribeCommandOutput for an unknown item streams an empty replace
